theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_cone_dilation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), C.massOn ((fun x => s • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) * C.massOn W) ∧ (∀ x : Euclid P, s • x ∈ C.support ↔ x ∈ C.support) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity C (s • x) θ ↔ HasMassDensity C x θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
